description: Soft-delete this organization. All members will be locked out and the org will be hidden until a platform admin restores it within the retention window. Call once with no token to preview; re-call with the returned confirm_token and an idempotency_key to commit. Owner role required.

confirm_token.description: Token returned by the preview (call this tool once with no token to get it). Required to commit; expires in ~10 minutes.

idempotency_key.description: Required when committing (confirm_token present): retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

name: delete_organization
